representation_fit.evidence: Brief shape=comparison-panel (few/high-density/compare-required, object=location): screenshots 1280x860 and 1440x900 show a 3-candidate × 7-row dense side-by-side matrix (契合分 57/34/63 with rank chips, per-criterion values + micro-bars + 行内最优「优」badges) beside a schematic geo map of the same 3 locations; source/data.js:14-21 defines 6 criteria with direction (better low/high), source/app.js:94-127 builds the matrix, source/app.js:28-63 computes the weighted fit — comparison literally is the task surface.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Matrix dominates the initial screen at both viewports (~69% width right column, 1280x860 and 1440x900); header lead states the decide job explicitly (source/index.html:16 「在 3 个候选铺位之间完成选址决策…」); persistent verdict bar names the current leader and offers the primary CTA 「锁定选择: C 环汇广场·商场铺」 (screenshot footer; source/app.js:286-291).

time_to_understand.evidence: Model-judged proxy: title + one-sentence lead explain what/where (source/index.html:15-16); column heads carry key, name, address and format (source/app.js:98-104); verdict bar reads as a sentence 「当前领先: C 环汇广场·商场铺 契合 63 分 · 领先第 2 名…关键差距: 人流规模 (15.0k vs 12.0k)」 (both screenshots); legend decodes all map symbols (source/index.html:106-113).

navigation_cost.evidence: Zero navigation: single static page, no routes/tabs/modes (source/index.html structure: header + main + footer only); all 3 candidate objects visible immediately in both matrix columns and map pins; selection is one click on column head or pin with two-way linkage (source/app.js:327-335, source/index.html:105), keyboard ←/→, 1–3, L, R equivalents (source/app.js:361-374).

context_loss.evidence: All primary actions mutate state in place with full re-render, no dialogs or page transitions (source/app.js:312-317); comparison state stays resident per brief requirement — sticky matrix header (source/styles.css:143-146), persistent aria-live verdict footer (source/index.html:137), lock preserves current selection context (source/app.js:306 state.locked = state.sel || lead.lead.id); map-info updates in place with selected site's walk context (source/app.js:203-204).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Six permanent surfaces (header, map, matrix, weights, verdict, footnote) each map to a brief requirement (density=high, compare=required, geo context co-screen); controls are exactly 3 column buttons + 3 pins + 6 weight sliders + reset + lock (source/index.html:117-133, source/app.js:232-248) — no superfluous chrome; cross-highlighting (row hover → map layer emphasis, source/app.js:211-229) adds capability without permanent controls; everything fits without page scroll at 1280x860.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt: a11y.contrast pass, a11y.focus_order pass, a11y.target_size pass, but type.min_projected_size FAIL (measurement-summary.json). Source shows deliberate a11y work: role=button + aria-pressed pins with aria-labels (source/index.html:77-94), aria-label on each range input and output[for] (source/app.js:236-238), scope=col/row headers (source/app.js:96-112), :focus-visible outline (source/styles.css:37), aria-live verdict, noscript fallback (source/index.html:143). Deduction: pervasive 9–11px micro-type — body 13px (source/styles.css:25), .anchor-sub 9px (styles.css:95), .map-micro/station/row-unit/site-addr 10px (styles.css:91,98,149,181) — consistent with the failing check.

frontend_rework.evidence: No visible layout defects: layout.overflow pass, layout.responsive_collision pass, text.truncation pass (measurement-summary.json); both screenshots clean — 1440x900 simply reveals one additional matrix row (一句话点评) that sits below the internal scroll fold at 1280x860, with sticky header compensating. Deduction: the single receipt error failure type.min_projected_size implies a rework pass to raise micro-type sizes; summary also carries 1 warning not attributable to a check id in the sanitized summary.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed 「地理语境与决策项同屏」: geo map and decision matrix are simultaneously visible in the initial viewport at both 1280x860 and 1440x900 (left panel vs right panel); the map carries the 3 candidate pins, metro line, commute anchor, competitors and flow corridors (source/index.html:29-114), selection highlights the same site on both surfaces and draws its walk-line to the station with live walk-time caption (source/app.js:192-208); lead sentence commits to the seed (source/index.html:16). Delivery constraints also met: static root index.html, inline data, synchronous init with no loading state (source/app.js:379-395).

defects_observed: type.min_projected_size FAIL in receipt (measurement-summary.json): multiple 9–11px projected text styles — .anchor-sub 9px (source/styles.css:95), .map-micro/.stn text/row units/.site-addr/badges 10px (styles.css:91,98,149,155,181) — below minimum legible projected size
一句话点评 matrix row falls below the fold inside the scrolling matrix at 1280x860 (visible only at 1440x900); mitigated by internal scroll + sticky header, not a layout-check failure
1 warning counted in measurement-summary.json summary that cannot be attributed to any named check in the sanitized summary
scores.overall_note: impl-06 is a faithful realization of the decide × comparison-panel brief: three location candidates are compared side-by-side in a dense weighted matrix whose aggregate 契合分, per-criterion best badges, adjustable weight sliders and a persistent leader/lock verdict bar make the comparison itself the primary work surface, while a schematic geo-context map of the same three sites stays co-visible at both measured viewports — directly satisfying the acceptance seed 地理语境与决策项同屏 (screenshots 1280x860/1440x900; source/index.html:16,29-133; source/app.js:94-127,265-298). Navigation cost is minimal (single static screen, one-click/one-key selection with two-way map↔matrix linkage, in-place state transitions, no modals or routes), and the receipt shows no layout, responsive, truncation, contrast, focus-order or target-size failures. The only measured defect is the type.min_projected_size failure caused by systematic 9–11px micro-labels across the map and matrix annotation layer (source/styles.css:91,95,98,149,181), which caps accessibility at 4 and implies one focused rework pass; model preference expressed here is a structural proxy and not a substitute for human preference, which remains unobserved in this pilot.
